product_metadata.title: Thickened Christmas Light Storage Bag with Cardboard Wraps Holiday Xmas Light Bulbs Storage Bags with Dual Zippered Closure (Red)
features: 【LIGHT STORAGE】- 3 thick cardboard wraps simplify the wrapping and storing of all your LED Christmas lights for organized, untangled storage that keeps them in top shape.
【NEVER TANGLE】 - Bag includes 2 round fabric-covered cardboard bases to separate between the light wraps ensuring your led strip lights remain untangled.

【DURABLE】 - Storage bag for Christmas lights made of durable nonwoven fabric which includes a sturdy zipper that closes the holiday storage bag completely to protect Christmas lights against dust, and dirt.

【EASY CARRY】 - The storage container for Christmas lights stitch-reinforced, generously sized handles make it easy to tote the icicle Xmas lights bag to and from Christmas storage room and decoration destinations.
【SIZE】 -These light storage bag are 12.6” in diameter and expandable to 14.2” tall.
